highlights: perfect for first time buyers, families and investors
description:
Ideally placed on this highly sought after street and available with no onward chain. This property offers the perfect opportunity for any prospective buyer looking for a home to put their own stamp onto and improve further. With two spacious reception rooms and three bedrooms, this property is ideal for first time buyers, families and investors and is available to view now. Accessed via entry vestibule, the main hallway gives further access to the ground floor accommodation. The living room to the front has bay window and the dining room to the rear has window overlooking the courtyard. There is then further access to the kitchen which is a good sized room. To the first floor the landing provides access to three bedrooms and the bathroom. The main bedroom in particular is a large double room. Externally there is on street parking and an enclosed forecourt to the front. To the rear is an enclosed courtyard with access gate and outhouse for storage.

ENTRANCE VESTIBULE

Accessed via glazed entry door.

MAIN HALLWAY With staircase to the first floor and access to the living accommodation.

LIVING ROOM Spacious reception room with bay window to the front.

DINING ROOM Further reception room with window to the rear.

KITCHEN With window and door to the side and understairs storage cupboard. Fitted with a mixture of wall and floor units, worktop, tiled splashback areas, sink unit and space for appliances.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING With access to the upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Large double room with two windows to the front.

BEDROOM TWO Further double room with window to the rear.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to the rear.

BATHROOM Mainly tiled with window to the side and fitted with suite comprising bath with overhead shower, wall mounted sink and w/c.

EXTERNALLY There is on street parking and an enclosed forecourt to the front. To the rear is an enclosed courtyard with access gate and outhouse for storage.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band B Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
